statement: Create beam elements from Rhino lines or curves with element identifiers, cross sections, materials and local-axis orientation, ready to assemble into a structural model.

statement: Create truss and tension-only cable elements from lines so axial-only members can be analysed with correct stiffness and slack behaviour.
